answer: The defence is an epoch-keyed hashcash stamp plus a countersignature quorum: each identity burns work over a seed nobody controls before its text is parsed, then waits for peers outside its subnet to counter-sign. A sybil farm pays the burn per key and never clears the quorum, so its influence stays flat while its bill grows. Seen from another angle the same logic runs through thread, ripple and signal: cost, not count, decides standing, and only work a stranger can re-derive moves an identity forward.
